Resources: Agent space account 012345678901_1, primary region us-east-1 (use list_associations to see other associated accounts; check other regions with snapshots if feasible, e.g. via describe_regions then checking regions that have snapshots).

- describe_snapshots with OwnerIds=['self'] (capture SnapshotId, VolumeId, VolumeSize, StartTime, Description, Tags, StorageTier, State).

- describe_volumes to see whether each snapshot's source VolumeId still exists (and whether it's attached/in-use).
- Also check whether snapshots are referenced by other things where cheap: Data Lifecycle Manager policies, AWS Backup (description starting with 'Created by CreateImage' / tags like aws:backup), snapshot lock, and whether newer snapshots of the same volume exist (snapshots are incremental, so deleting an older one may free little space).

- Report counts per category and a concise table of snapshots (ID, size, age, category, notes, recommendation).
